_readme: WoowTech code-server 完整指南 的中英詞彙對照。terms 為譯名對照，keepEnglish 為維持英文原樣的詞，forbid 為禁用譯法。
principles: Use US English and sentence case.
Preserve product names, configuration keys, commands, file names, versions, and placeholders exactly.
Use direct second-person instructions and retain every warning, limitation, version boundary, and verification step.
Every chapter must state which of the two flavours (Home Assistant add-on or Podman package) it applies to.
Never present any credential as a working value; placeholders only.
forbid: the two flavours are the same product
